# Which selections survive and remain executable when the lumping changes

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

On the existing Process/Trace/Run, relations at configurations describe indistinguishability. Where the old relation is an equivalence, every selection through the old lumping is expressible through the new lumping iff new indistinguishability implies old indistinguishability; a merged old pair supplies a lost choice. Preservation composes through actual intermediate configurations, with a direct adapter to Web selection. Retaining actual records keeps selections and can add distinctions, but the history itself provides no memory mechanism. Execution follows the general laws of stock (Becoming.Stock), for every process: balance at each step is balance along every course; where steps draw only on what is held, a course is executable exactly where each step’s draw is within the stock then standing, and, run jointly with a process, exactly where that process admits it and the stock covers it. Revising is an instance: a link process run jointly with its stock (Revising.step_iff, Revising.feasible_iff), which consumes support to form a distinguishing link, replenishes support, then changes response from false to the supplied target true; the same process permits closing the link. As laws, discrimination, support and enactment are distinct: a correction the stock covers can be blocked by the link process, and one the link admits can lack stock (Revising.covered_not_enacted, Revising.linked_not_enacted); increased discrimination does not entail executable action, and remaining support does not entail remaining discrimination.

Canonical source: [Revision.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Revision.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Old reflexivity, symmetry and transitivity are explicit. The process, alternative domain and the lumping at each configuration are supplied. The trace theorem requires preservation at the stated steps, rather than claiming every revision preserves distinctions.
- The instance supplies replenishment, two rebuild modes, apparatus-to-reading correspondence, target true and a controller preferring reconstruction. Stock and apparatus status enter control; reconstruction is not chosen solely through the initial reading, which lumps the two modes.
- Actual memory retention, unrepresented effects and physical correspondence require separate accounts. No normative premise or universally positive cost is assumed.

P93 connects the existing common-organization study to the unified spine. Lumping, selection, support and response are differentiated relations of one process; the local tuple preserves only the stated connections. Empty Lean axiom reports do not discharge substantive construction laws or the target. Author counterreview separates apparatus formation, retained record, expressible choice and actual execution.

- opens_without_correction gains a distinction while exhausting action support; closes_choice loses an old selection despite remaining stock; old_cannot_select_rebuild shows the initial reading alone cannot distinguish reconstruction modes. As laws: covered_not_enacted is a correction the stock covers and the link process blocks, and linked_not_enacted one the link admits with no stock to cover it.
